paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.49% on average, with S&P 500 strongest (+1.15%) and Euro Stoxx 50 weakest (-1.04%). Brent crude changed +3.00% to 103.33. Gold changed +1.57% to 4,222.0. Bitcoin changed -1.77% to 84,041.6406. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.244%, a relative move of -0.63%. Among the firms tracked, 3i Group (-5.99%) and ConocoPhillips (+5.80%) moved the most.
